user.title: Add Accent & Signal Light
user.description: Configure a new Accent & Signal Light instance that will manage a physical light entity using a three-layer priority model (base / accent / signal).

data_description.name: A friendly name for this instance (e.g. 'Living Room Accent & Signal Light').
data_description.signal_wake_priority: Signals must have a priority greater than this value to turn the light on while the base layer is off.
data_description.underlying_entity_id: The light entity that Accent & Signal Light will control.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Accent & Signal Light
reconfigure.description: Change the underlying light entity, signal wake priority, or name of this Accent & Signal Light instance. Entity IDs and existing accent/signal state are unaffected.
